title: Fractional topology and multi-period re-quantization in open quantum systems
summary: We study fractional topological numbers in open quantum systems described by the Gorin--Kossakowski--Sudarsha--Lindblad master equation. Under symmetry conditions ensuring quantization, we show that single-valued physical states in momentum space give rise to integer winding numbers that remain integer during time evolution. Fractional values arise when this condition is effectively relaxed, such that the topology is evaluated over a restricted sector or exhibits an effective multi-branch structure.
